tagline: Because your garage band’s lead guitarist keeps forgetting the lyrics, and now you need a speaker that can keep up with his ego. These Fender Bluetooth speakers are perfect for when you’re jamming in the backyard and your neighbor’s dog starts howling along—at least now the dog will sound better than your bassist.

title: Beer Me, iPhone
tagline: For that one friend who can't adult without cracking open a cold one, even at their desk. This case is a bottle opener, because priorities.

title: Hydrate to the Beat
tagline: For when you need to annoy your kayaking buddies with tunes while staying hydrated, this water bottle speaker is a weirdly great idea.

title: Weather for People Who Forgot Windows
tagline: For the office worker who’s convinced their windowless cubicle is a black hole, this ambient display brings the outside in—without the risk of actual sunlight. Perfect for when you need to know if it’s raining so you can justify ordering takeout instead of going to the mailbox.

title: Podcast Like It's 1999
tagline: For when your Zoom calls need the warm, crackly charm of a dial-up modem. Perfect for recording ASMR of your grandma’s rotary phone or narrating your vinyl collection in lo-fi glory. Bonus: It’s the only mic that’ll make your neighbors think you’re secretly a pirate radio DJ.

title: Retro Gaming Grip
tagline: For when you need to play Snake on your iPhone while nostalgic for blowing on NES cartridges, this case is a weirdly perfect fit.

title: Scanner in Your Pocket, Not Your Imagination
tagline: For the 'I'll scan it later' procrastinator who also happens to be a spy. This pocket-sized scanner is perfect for when you need to digitize your grocery list while pretending to take a selfie. Just don't try scanning your cat—it won't appreciate the beep.

title: Fancy Your Phone in Marble
tagline: For when your phone needs to match your countertops. Perfect for that one friend who insists on taking photos of their charcuterie boards. The marble case gives your phone the gravitas it needs to sit next to a wedge of brie without looking out of place.

title: Selfix: For Serial Selfie Offenders
tagline: Finally, a case for people who peaked in high school! This… *thing*… is for when holding your phone a mere foot from your face just isn't 'grammable' enough. Need to capture that triple chin from a bird's eye view? This is your enabler. Go ahead, buy it. I'm sure your landlord understands that rent is less important than thirst traps.

title: Stick Your Tablet to Your PC Like a Fridge Magnet
tagline: For those who've ever wanted to turn their PC into a makeshift iPad stand while multitasking between gaming and watching cat videos. This magnetic mount is the love child of a tablet and a refrigerator magnet, perfect for when you're too lazy to switch screens or just really into the 'minimalist' look of a tablet stuck to your monitor.

title: Touchscreen for Your Grandpa’s CRT
tagline: Because your 1998 Sony Trinitron deserves a second chance at relevance. Perfect for when your toddler insists on poking the screen during *The Price Is Right* reruns, or your cat needs to swipe through *Animal Planet* like it’s Instagram. Just don’t expect it to work with your VHS player—some miracles are too much to ask for.

title: Lawn Envy, iPhone Edition
tagline: Tired of your phone blending into the abyss of your pocket? Now you can lose it in a patch of grass instead. Perfect for the urban gardener who wants to feel connected to nature—while still being able to check their email. Bonus: Confuses cats and makes your phone calls sound like you're in a meadow.

title: Glow-in-the-Dark iPhone Armor
tagline: For when you need your phone to double as a nightlight during your 3 AM existential crisis. This case isn't just for visibility—it's for signaling to the universe that you're still here, still scrolling, still pretending everything's fine. Perfect for those 'I dropped my phone in the dark and now it's a UFO' moments.

title: Type Like a Time Traveler (Vintage Styled)
tagline: For the person who insists their emails need a 'vintage aesthetic,' this keyboard is the perfect blend of modern wireless convenience and the clackety-clack of a 1980s word processor. Ideal for drafting your next manifesto in a dimly lit café while sipping espresso from a mug that says 'I ❤️ DOS.'

title: MacBook Sticker: Time Travel for Your Laptop
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm a retro tech enthusiast' like slapping a sticker of a computer that's older than your college degree on your modern laptop. Perfect for that café where the barista asks if you want a 'drip' or a 'pour-over'—because clearly, you're all about the vintage vibes. Just don't be surprised if someone mistakes your MacBook for a museum piece.

title: The Earbuds' Chaperone
tagline: For when your vintage Walkman refuses to let go of its headphone jack, but you still want to pretend you're living in 2023. Perfect for the gym rat who insists on listening to cassette tapes while bench pressing, or the hipster who wants to prove they can still be retro and wireless at the same time. Just don't blame us when your mixtape skips mid-jog.

title: Macro Lens for Ants Who Love Portraits
tagline: Tired of your macro shots looking like they were taken with a potato? This lens is for when you need to photograph a grain of sand’s family reunion. Perfect for entomologists who want to give their subjects a glamour shot before pinning them to a board. Bonus: The f/14 aperture means you’ll finally see what’s living in your keyboard.

title: Cord With A Secret
tagline: For when you're stuck on a bus with a dead phone and a stranger's suspiciously long charging cord, this powerbank-filled cord is a lifesaver – or a conversation starter.

title: Brain Chopper: No Assembly Needed!
tagline: For the executive who's already micromanaging everyone's thoughts, now you can pilot a tiny helicopter with *your own*. Finally, a way to passive-aggressively adjust the thermostat from across the room. Just be sure to clear your mind of cat videos; that's how accidents happen.

title: Juice Box for Grown-Ups
tagline: For when your 'emergency' is actually just forgetting to charge your phone before a 3-hour Zoom call about why your spreadsheet isn't working. This bag holds enough power to keep your devices alive through a blackout, a camping trip, or that one friend who always shows up with a dead phone and expects you to have a charger.

title: Finger Trap for Your Phone
tagline: Ever tried to take a selfie while holding your phone, a coffee, and your dignity? This case turns your iPhone into a ring you can’t lose—literally. Perfect for the person who’s always dropping things but refuses to buy a lanyard. Now you can scroll through memes while your thumb does all the heavy lifting.

title: Headphones for Forgetful Geniuses
tagline: Ever forget your headphones mid-commute, only to realize they're still at home? Enter the Wristband Headphones—your stylish, wearable backup. Perfect for the absent-minded audiophile who needs a plan B for their daily playlist. Just pop them on your wrist, and you're good to go. No more frantic pat-downs of your pockets.

title: Wi-Fi for Your Lanyard
tagline: Ever been at a conference, drowning in a sea of identical name tags, when suddenly you need to share your contact info with that one person who just complimented your socks? This badge turns your lanyard into a business card on steroids. No more awkwardly fumbling for your phone—just a tap and your LinkedIn is in their hands. Perfect for networking introverts who’d rather be napping.

title: Phone for People Who Hate Phones
tagline: The perfect device for when you want to tell your boss you're 'in a meeting' while actually just staring at a wall. No apps, no distractions—just a phone that makes calls and texts, because apparently, some of us still remember what those are. Ideal for the minimalist who's tired of pretending to care about their Instagram feed.

title: Alexa, Print My Existential Dread
tagline: For when yelling reminders at a cylinder just isn't passive-aggressive enough. Now, Alexa can silently judge your poor life choices by printing them on a tiny adhesive square. Perfect for passive-aggressive roommates who communicate solely through fridge manifestos about who ate the last yogurt.

title: Bar None Lighting
tagline: For the 3am gamer who needs ambient RGB to fuel their raid, these smart light bars bring the disco to your desk, because who needs sleep when you can have synchronized lighting?

title: Synth for the Rest of Us
tagline: Ever wanted to compose a symphony while hiding from your in-laws in the garage? This DIY synth kit lets you build your own noise-maker without needing a degree in electrical engineering. Perfect for the aspiring bedroom composer who's also a closet handyman. Just don't blame us if your neighbors start a petition.

title: Sun Savior in a Pinch
tagline: For when you're lost in the woods with a dead phone and a strong desire to Google how to start a fire.

title: Spy, Meet Your Match
tagline: For when you're paranoid your ISP is judging you, Winston's got your back. Literally, it's a box that sits between you and the internet, keeping your browsing habits private. Because who needs that kind of stress?

title: Laser Beam to Your Wall
tagline: For when you want to project your favorite shows onto the wall at 3am, but don't want to bother with a TV, this ultra short throw laser projector is the answer to your weirdly specific problem.

title: Loud and Broke
tagline: For when you need to annoy your campsite neighbors with decent sound quality, but not decent enough to justify the price, this battery-powered speaker is the perfect overkill for your next wilderness rave.

title: Webcam for Professional Oversharers
tagline: Is your current webcam failing to capture the nuance of your aggressively lit home office during those 3 AM emergency Zoom calls with your European supervisor? The Razer Kiyo Pro ensures every bead of sweat and panicked eye twitch is rendered in glorious HD. Finally, a way to truly weaponize your vulnerability.

title: Mouse in the Dark
tagline: When your cat knocks over your lamp, this infrared projection mouse saves the day, or at least your late-night browsing session.

title: Car Savior in a Box
tagline: Because you forgot to turn off your headlights, again. This smart jump starter saves your dead battery, and your dignity, in embarrassing parking lot situations.

title: Spy on Your Cat
tagline: For when you need proof your cat's judging you from the couch, this indoor cam has got you covered. Place it near the snacks, and finally, you'll know who's behind the missing chips.

title: Bulbs on a Leash
tagline: For when you're too lazy to get up and flip a switch, but still want to impress your roommate with your 'smart' home skills.

title: Sonic Indulgence for Elites
tagline: For when you need to block out your roommate's existential crisis at 3 AM, these $1,649.99 headphones will envelop you in pure audio bliss, or at least drown out the sound of their midnight pizza eating.

title: Rave in a Box
tagline: For when you need to annoy your neighbors with a portable party, the JBL Party Box 300 is here. Because who needs peace and quiet, anyway?

title: May the Bass Be
tagline: For when you need to immerse yourself in a galaxy far, far away, but your roommate's snoring is the Death Star of your focus.

title: HDMI Freedom Fighter
tagline: For when you need to stream from the couch to the TV, but your significant other hogged the only HDMI port with their gaming console, and you're too lazy to get up and switch cables.

title: Shell Shocked Sound
tagline: For when you want to annoy your beach neighbors with tinny tunes, this sea shell speaker is oddly perfect. It's like a hermit crab's boombox, but less useful for actual crabs.

title: Sleep Judge Arrives
tagline: For the friend who needs proof they're sleeping 12 hours a day, this tracker provides undeniable evidence of their impressive napping skills, perfect for silencing skeptics at 3am gaming sessions.

title: Lens Madness Ensues
tagline: For when you need to zoom in on that one weird cousin at a wedding from 50 feet away without arousing suspicion.

title: Mech Keys for the Win
tagline: For when you want to annoy your coworkers with loud typing, the Keychron K3 mechanical keyboard is here. Perfect for that one guy who types with reckless abandon at 3 AM in a shared office space.

title: Spy Ball of Doom
tagline: For when you need to surveil your roommate's snack habits or monitor the cat's napping schedule, this rolling robot's got you covered.

title: Print Regrets Instantly
tagline: For when you need physical proof of your questionable life choices, like that tattoo of your ex's face, this printer spits out iPhone photos in seconds, because who needs discretion?

title: Netflix and Chill...Sheets?
tagline: So, your desktop PC is now a glorified streaming box? Fine. But admit it: you're tired of squinting at Hulu while 'working from home.' This Samsung monitor is basically a TV that *pretends* to be for productivity. Ideal for those who primarily use Excel to track their progress through 'The Real Housewives' franchise.

title: Time to Get Weird
tagline: For the friend who's always late to dinner parties, this $1,050 text clock is a great conversation starter – or a reminder that they're still running behind, even with a fancy clock that spells out the time in words.

title: Hydrogen Hoarder
tagline: For the prepper who wants to store energy, not just canned beans, this hydrogen storage is a real treat. Imagine powering your bunker's espresso machine during the apocalypse.

title: Drive Like a Spy
tagline: For when you need to navigate while keeping an eye on the road and your fantasy football scores, this heads-up display is a weirdly practical solution.
